info.title: Brisa API
info.description: Certified invoicing for Angola (AGT). Every call carries a bearer token: a Keycloak access token for a person, or an API key (`brk_...`) for a company's own integration. The company is the token's `tid` (or the key's), and what the caller may do is decided by the permissions held in that company (RBAC with conditions; a key holds a short list of its own). Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. Companies are told about events through signed webhooks.

servers.description: Produção e sandbox (a chave escolhe o ambiente)

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document. Other members may appear: ignore the ones you do not know.

bearer.description: Um token de acesso do Keycloak (uma pessoa) ou uma chave de API da empresa: `brk_<empresa>_<id>_<segredo>` (produção) ou `brk_sbx..._<id>_<segredo>` (sandbox).
